pick.headline: Cardinal Karol Wojtyla of Krakow elected Pope
pick.summary: On 16 October 1978 the conclave elected Cardinal Karol Wojtyla, Archbishop of Krakow, as Pope John Paul II, the first non-Italian pope in over four centuries.
pick.significance: A Polish pope transformed the politics of the Soviet bloc. The Polish security service and the KGB watched him closely, and his 1979 visit to Poland preceded the rise of Solidarity.
